initialTimeout.harnessMismatch: The old harness intercepted every HTMLCanvasElement.getContext before normal startup, including capability and SDF contexts, and eagerly queried LINK_STATUS after every startup shader link. The corrected observer is installed only on the mounted actual renderer after normal proof/annotation readiness; connected live draws remain required.
initialTimeout.proofReadyLifecycle: DrawingLinework publishes ready:true; the flag is present. No production readiness flag was removed or synthesized.

fontReadinessRootCause: Typesetter returns fontData metrics but no top-level capHeight; TextBuilder still copies result.capHeight, so live TextRenderInfo.capHeight is undefined/null although glyph atlas, glyph count, font, bounds and rendering are ready.
capProof: Each live visible ink height must agree with source TTF fontHeight * actual fontSize / 1000 within max(1e-8 metres, expected height * 1e-5).
checksPreserved: actual reference font URL and successful response
live SDF atlas and exactly one glyph per letter
finite nonempty visible bounds and positive font size
actual scene/camera/renderer and connected live draws
